### Estética y práctica creativa

### Historia del arte y culturas

Groups: 14 · Skills: 59

[artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/artHistoryAndCultures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Artworks and artistic practices develop within particular communities, historical debates, patrons and material technologies. Study of art history distinguishes movements and named traditions through their own works and contexts rather than treating an entire continent or historical era as a single skill. This domain examines art-historical interpretation, not general political chronology.

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo las obras de arte reflejan lugares, comunidades, épocas y debates artísticos concretos.

##### Analizar las tradiciones de mascarada Gelede

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo las máscaras, los trajes y las representaciones Gelede yoruba se integran en la vida comunitaria.

##### Analizar las figuras nkisi del Kongo

[analyzeKongoNkisiFigures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artHistoryAndCultures/westAndCentralAfricanTraditions/skills/analyzeKongoNkisiFigures.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora los materiales y las funciones culturales de las figuras nkisi del Kongo.

### Comprensión y crítica artística

Groups: 4 · Skills: 18

[artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpretation of artistic work depends on the medium, formal relationships, intentions and cultural contexts. This field supports attentive analysis of existing artworks rather than instruction in a particular material technique.

**User-friendly description (es):** Descubre cómo las decisiones artísticas y el contexto cultural nos ayudan a comprender y debatir las obras.

#### Comisariado y presentación

[analyzeDisplayContext.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/analyzeDisplayContext.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Explora cómo la luz, la escala, la ubicación y las etiquetas influyen en la presentación de una obra.

[selectWorksForAnExhibition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/selectWorksForAnExhibition.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Elige obras que funcionen juntas para un tema y un público determinados.

[sequenceAnExhibition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/sequenceAnExhibition.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (es):** Ordena las obras para crear conexiones y contrastes significativos.

[writeExhibitionInterpretationText.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/curationAndPresentation/skills/writeExhibitionInterpretationText.data.ts)

[analyzeTextureAndSurface.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formalLanguage/skills/analyzeTextureAndSurface.data.ts)

Skills: 4

[formsAndPurposes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/formsAndPurposes/formsAndPurposes.data.ts)

##### Distinguir medios artísticos

**Methodological description (English):** Infer plausible aims from artistic choices, distinguishing supported observations from assumptions about the creator.

**User-friendly description (es):** Utiliza pistas de una obra para explorar qué pudo haber querido expresar su creador.

#### Interpretación y evaluación

Skills: 5

[interpretationAndEvaluation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/interpretationAndEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judgments about art become more useful when observable evidence, contextual claims and chosen evaluative criteria are stated separately.

**User-friendly description (es):** Aprende a debatir qué puede significar una obra utilizando pruebas y criterios claros.

##### Comparar interpretaciones artísticas

[compareArtisticInterpretations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/compareArtisticInterpretations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how different plausible readings explain the same evidence and where each is limited.

**User-friendly description (es):** Compara distintas interpretaciones de una obra y las pruebas que respaldan cada una.

##### Describir obras de arte con precisión

[describeArtworksPrecisely.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/describeArtworksPrecisely.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Report recognizable features and formal relationships before advancing an account of their meaning.

**User-friendly description (es):** Describe los detalles que realmente puedes ver u oír antes de explicar su significado.

##### Distinguir la observación de la interpretación

[distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/distinguishObservationFromInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate directly perceptible details from symbolic, emotional or biographical inferences.

**User-friendly description (es):** Distingue entre lo que observas y lo que crees que significa.

##### Evaluar el arte mediante criterios

[evaluateArtUsingCriteria.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/evaluateArtUsingCriteria.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply explicit standards appropriate to a work's purpose without treating personal taste as universal fact.

**User-friendly description (es):** Evalúa una obra con criterios claros y adecuados a sus objetivos, no solo según tus gustos.

##### Respaldar una interpretación artística

[supportAnArtisticInterpretation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/art/data/skills/artisticUnderstandingAndCriticism/interpretationAndEvaluation/skills/supportAnArtisticInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Defend a reading with identifiable artistic decisions and context relevant to the work.

**User-friendly description (es):** Utiliza detalles de la obra para explicar y respaldar tu interpretación.
